description: What the two Alexia windows may ask this process to do: set the tray's tooltip, hide the overlay, restart after an update, check for one, start at sign-in, and read the machine's temperature sensors for the Local stats page.

remote.comment: The shell is served by core over loopback, so the page is a remote origin from Tauri's point of view. Only that origin, and only the permissions below. A remote origin may call the app's own commands only where they are granted here by name, so every command in main.rs's generate_handler! has its allow- line.
